episodes.synopsis: For her first day as a concierge at Pokémon Resort, all Haru has to do is enjoy herself on the island as if she were a guest herself!
episodes.title: I'm Haru, the New Concierge!

episodes.synopsis: Psyduck suffers from chronic headaches that erupt into disruptive psychic powers. Can Haru come up with a way to help?
episodes.title: What's on Your Mind, Psyduck?

episodes.synopsis: When a Magikarp who can't swim well loses his floatie to a passing Wingull, Haru and Psyduck fly after it on a Dragonite to try and get it back.
episodes.title: I Hope I Can Evolve Too…

episodes.synopsis: Haru meets a shy little Pikachu who's trainer really wants him to be more outgoing. But here at Pokémon Resort, everyone is encouraged to be themselves.
episodes.title: Welcome to the Pokémon Resort!
